```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-funding-vs-dalys-averted
#| fig-cap: "Total DALYs averted as a function of annual funding level. The curve flattens as funding approaches the asymptotic ceiling where all avoidable diseases receive accelerated treatment. Efficacy lag elimination (8.2 years) provides a fixed baseline benefit independent of funding scale."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    setup_chart_style, add_watermark, clean_spines, add_png_metadata,
    get_figure_output_path, COLOR_BLACK, COLOR_WHITE
)
from dih_models.dfda_trial_economics import (
    compute_at_funding_level, compute_across_funding_levels,
    get_ceiling_dalys, get_efficacy_lag_dalys,
)

setup_chart_style()

# ── Computation via shared library ─────────────────────────────────────

sweep = compute_across_funding_levels()
funding_levels = sweep["funding_levels"]
dalys_averted = sweep["dalys_averted"]

proposed = compute_at_funding_level()  # defaults to proposed treaty funding
ceiling_dalys = get_ceiling_dalys()
efficacy_only_dalys = get_efficacy_lag_dalys()

# Unpack proposed values for annotations

pf = proposed["funding"]
proposed_multiplier = proposed["multiplier"]
proposed_clearance = proposed["clearance_years"]
proposed_total_shift = proposed["total_shift"]
proposed_dalys = proposed["dalys_averted"]

# ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 11))

valid = ~np.isnan(dalys_averted)
ax.plot(funding_levels[valid] / 1e9, dalys_averted[valid] / 1e9,
        linewidth=3.5, color=COLOR_BLACK, linestyle='-')

# Asymptotic ceiling

ax.axhline(y=ceiling_dalys / 1e9, color=COLOR_BLACK, linestyle=':', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5)
ax.text(0.03, 0.97,
        f'Ceiling: {ceiling_dalys/1e9:.0f}B DALYs\n(all avoidable diseases treated\nas fast as possible)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=20, color=COLOR_BLACK, va='top', ha='left',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1, alpha=0.9))

# Efficacy lag baseline

ax.axhline(y=efficacy_only_dalys / 1e9, color=COLOR_BLACK, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.4)
ax.text(0.03, 0.12,
        f'Efficacy lag elimination only:\n{efficacy_only_dalys/1e9:.0f}B DALYs (fixed baseline,\nindependent of funding)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=20, color=COLOR_BLACK, va='bottom', ha='left',
        style='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1, alpha=0.9))

# Mark proposed funding

ax.plot(pf / 1e9, proposed_dalys / 1e9,
        marker='o', markersize=14, color=COLOR_BLACK, zorder=5)

avoidable_pct = float(EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DALY_PCT)
annual_daly_burden = float(GLOBAL_ANNUAL_DALY_BURDEN)

ax.annotate(
    f'Proposed Treaty: {proposed_dalys/1e9:.0f}B DALYs\n'
    f'${pf/1e9:.1f}B/yr, {proposed_multiplier:.1f}x capacity\n'
    f'{proposed_total_shift:.0f}-yr avg. treatment shift\n'
    f'queue cleared in {proposed_clearance:.0f} yrs\n'
    f'{proposed_dalys/ceiling_dalys*100:.0f}% of theoretical ceiling\n'
    f'= {annual_daly_burden/1e9:.1f}B/yr x {avoidable_pct*100:.0f}% x {proposed_total_shift:.0f} yrs',
    xy=(pf / 1e9, proposed_dalys / 1e9),
    xytext=(0.50, 0.40), textcoords='axes fraction',
    fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_BLACK,
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
              edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=2.5),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=2.5))

# Causal explanation annotations

ax.text(0.97, 0.20,
        'High funding: acceleration\napproaches ceiling at\n1/k saturation',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=20, color=COLOR_BLACK, va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1, alpha=0.9))

# Axes

ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlabel('Annual Funding Level ($B)', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_BLACK)
ax.set_ylabel('Total DALYs Averted (Billions)', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_BLACK)
ax.set_title('DALYs Averted vs. Funding Level',
             fontsize=28, fontweight='bold', pad=30, color=COLOR_BLACK)
ax.text(0.5, 1.01,
        f'Acceleration formula: T = T_baseline x (1 - 1/k) where k = trial capacity multiplier',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=18, color=COLOR_BLACK, ha='center', va='bottom')

ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=18)

from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'${x:.0f}B' if x >= 1 else f'${x*1000:.0f}M'))
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda y, _: f'{y:.0f}B'))

clean_spines(ax)
add_watermark(fig)

output_path = get_figure_output_path('funding-vs-dalys-averted-line-chart.png')
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.3, facecolor=COLOR_WHITE)
add_png_metadata(
    output_path,
    title="DALYs Averted vs. Funding Level",
    description="Shows total DALYs averted as funding increases, with an asymptotic ceiling as the 1/k acceleration formula saturates."
)
plt.show()

# Print verification

print(f"\nVerification at proposed funding (${pf/1e9:.1f}B/yr):")
print(f"  Trial capacity multiplier: {proposed_multiplier:.1f}x")
print(f"  Queue clearance: {proposed_clearance:.1f} years")
print(f"  Treatment acceleration: {proposed['accel_years']:.1f} years")
print(f"  Total timeline shift: {proposed_total_shift:.1f} years")
print(f"  DALYs averted: {proposed_dalys/1e9:.0f}B")
print(f"  Ceiling DALYs: {ceiling_dalys/1e9:.0f}B")
print(f"  Utilization: {proposed_dalys/ceiling_dalys*100:.1f}% of ceiling")
print(f"  Efficacy lag baseline: {efficacy_only_dalys/1e9:.0f}B DALYs")
```
